results.content:
Eleven short episodes, titled Frieren: Beyond Journey's End – Spell That Does OOO (葬送のフリーレン ～●●の魔法～, Sōsō no Frieren: Marumaru no Mahō), were released on Toho Animation's YouTube channel and on Frieren's official anime X and TikTok accounts from October 11, 2023, to March 24, 2024. A second six-episode season was released from April 2 to September 3, 2025. A third five-episode season was released from January 19 to March 26, 2026.

In many respects, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 2 picks up exactly where Season 1 left us. But in other ways, it subtly takes a different turn. With a first episode that deftly mirrors our very first introduction to the story, the newest installment announces from the get-go that the journey ... is about re-tracing the journey of the Party of Heroes with Frieren’s new companions: and it feels apparent now, that Frieren herself is [...] of light fantasy. The mood is often melancholic, as it protrays characters expressing human emotions. At times, it also pokes fun of Frieren's emotional outbursts such as her childlike crying in one of the episodes. Other times, humans such as Stark draws an emotional feeling with how his character behaves. Both theme songs also work so effectively to convey that mood.
